name: Print-Through
desc: What the next wrap of the reel remembers — an image from seconds ago bleeds back into this one as a warm latent stain, drifting and slowly turning against the live frame, printed unevenly wherever the film was pressed hardest so the transfer comes through in patches rather than as a clean second exposure.

energy.doc: transfer strength and how hard the uneven pressure mottles it

offset.doc: how far the ghost drifts, turns and swells off register

density.doc: number of stacked ghosts and mottle patches

tint.doc: how far the transfer stains toward the base colour rather than staying a plain copy (this is what makes it read over a dark scene)

delay.doc: how far back in time the ghost is drawn from

style.doc: aesthetic: soft warm latent stain off the reel / crisper deliberate in-camera multiple exposure at wide register / abstract Sabattier tonal inversion where the ghost lands / heavy chemical bleed, swollen and soft

act.doc: multi-minute program: drift holds a steady transfer / wind slowly winds the register in and out over ~a minute / expose lets the transfer swell with the arc and the music
